parts.t: STUNNING 3-level with bright fully finished basement in Prestigious Mossey Estates! Incredible covered outdoor living area & large private WEST exposed rear yard. Beautiful covered HOT TUB. Spacious open plan flooded with natural light from a west-facing yard, perfect for entertaining. Gorgeous gourmet kitchen with large breakfast bar island, pantry & high-end appliances open to the living room. Mudroom, den & office on the main. Four large bedrooms up - spectacular primary with walk-in closet & spa-inspired ensuite w/dual vanity, walk-in shower & soaker tub. The basement boasts a separate entrance, a large rec/games room, family/media room, 2 bedrooms & bathroom complete this impressive home. EASILY SUITABLE!
